#!/bin/bash
# The recall and the loads of the 10M index grown with the series, at 0.95
# and 0.99 (bench-report.md of feat/posting-edge-index, amendment of 21:00 of
# 2026-11-27): TestNightPoints, untimed, with points.test built from
# grow10m/src (44c35ee9b9, the night harness and bench_night_points_test.go).
# Nothing here is timed: no marker and no wait.
set -u
S=/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-abdel-Documents-Projects-hnsw-pq-wt-posting-edge-index/e94130d1-0af4-421d-89c2-936de2c15159/scratchpad
G=$S/grow10m
cd $G/src/adapters/repos/db/vector/postingedge || exit 2
date "+== %Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S points"
PE_DATASET=$HOME/Documents/datasets/wikidpr-10m-e5-inplace.bin PE_DIR=$G/index PE_CACHE=routing \
  PE_POINTS=$G/points-routing.json PE_THREADS=8 \
  $G/points.test -test.run '^TestNightPoints$' -test.v -test.timeout 0 > $G/points-routing.log 2>&1
echo "points exit $?"
date "+== %H:%M:%S done"
